properties.popup_body:
Zara designs and produces its own products based on the latest trends and catwalk designs. With its unique ordering process, Zara is able to create and deliver products to its stores faster than any other retailer and is able to offer the most stylish and fashionable products at affordable prices.

The store has fashion and fragrances for women, men and children.

Location: Cabot Place

properties.name: Adam Grooming Atelier
properties.popup_body: Welcome to ADAM: a grooming atelier for gentlemen who are seeking a timeless barbering experience to complement their lifestyles. The ADAM experience is not about the latest trend or bygone era, it’s about stepping into a contemporary, uncluttered space, indulging in the artful hands and discerning eye of our barbers, and walking out feeling restored and looking sharp and polished.

properties.name: Santander
properties.popup_body: A complete specialist financial service including bank accounts, mortgages, investments and a wide range of savings.

properties.name: Boisdale of Canary Wharf
properties.popup_body:
Boisdale of Canary Wharf is a two-floor venue overlooking Cabot Square which comprises a restaurant, four private dining rooms, Oyster Bar & Grill with a terrace, whisky bar, Cuban Cigar Library & shop and live music venue.

The restaurant's music programme comes with the seal of approval of no less than Jools Holland, Boisdale's Patron of Music. The programme is packed with the best in jazz, blues and soul and highlights have included performances by the likes of Georgie Fame, Ruby Turner, Cuban legend Chucho Valdes, Chris Barber, Big Boy Bloater, Ruben Richards, Acker Bilk, Buddy Greco, Stephen Triffitt, The Congo Faith Healers, Mitch Winehouse, Mud Morganfield and many more.

The second floor restaurant is decorated in the instantly recognisable Boisdale signature look of lacquer red and dark green walls hung with eclectic and original artwork. It is here that one can find the whisky bar, a 12 metre long 'amber wall of liquid gold' that holds over 1,000 bottles of malt whisky. One floor below is the art deco-inspired Oyster Bar & Grill which benefits from an awning-covered heated terrace complete with members-only area. Four private dining rooms are available, accommodating from 12 to 40 guests.

Location: Cabot Place

properties.name: HCA
properties.popup_body:
Located in the heart of the City, Canary Wharf Outpatients is purpose-built to give you easy access to expert, preventative care and state-of-the-art diagnostics as soon as you need it.
	
From the call to consultation, we provide a fast track to a vast network of leading specialists and GPs, well-versed in treating any condition, no matter how complex. 
	
And it’s all right here, at your convenience.

properties.name: Pergola On The Wharf
properties.popup_body:
Pergola On The Wharf is a botanical waterside Eden, grown for naturally good times. Flooded with natural light from the floor-to-ceiling windows and strewn with lush flora, vines and ferns, the huge space plays host to three bars, food pop-ups, drinking, dancing, live music and DJ sets late into the night. Perched above Canary Wharf’s northern dock with panoramic views, feel free to live it up inside amongst the foliage or enjoy the fresh air on our 200 capacity terrace which wraps around the venue.

As well as a rotating roster of London’s best up and coming street food concepts, Pergola On The Wharf has an in-house restaurant, centred around an open kitchen where you can watch our chefs prepare your meal from scratch using fresh ingredients. In keeping with the natural feel of the venue, dishes on the menu are based around the core elements of ‘Earth, Land and Sea’, emphasising provenance, freshness and seasonality. As always, our drinks menu has been created in partnership with London’s finest distilleries, breweries and wine merchants.

With a tantalising programme of events still to be announced, get ready to drink, dance and party all summer long at Pergola On The Wharf, grown for naturally good times.

Location: Crossrail Place

properties.popup_body:
Inspired by the 19th century shacks and Bar.B.Q joints of the American Gulf Coast, Big Easy has been serving authentic bar.b.q and fresh seafood all to the soundtrack of Blues since 1991. Bringing you over 500 whiskies, signature slushie cocktails, an award winning wine list and live Blues music 7 nights a week in a fun and relaxed environment.

Canary Wharf is the biggest Big Easy to date; located in Crossrail Place at park level with a huge roof terrace with sweeping views over Canary Wharf, an oyster bar and private dining rooms.

properties.name: ROKA
properties.popup_body:
ROKA is a meeting place where food and drinks are shared with friends (Ro) and heat, warmth and an all-embracing energy surround (Ka). The principle cuisine is from the Robata grill, which originates from the fishermen of the Northern coastal waters off Japan, who would cook the fish on the boats with different charcoals and share the bounty with one another using their oars.

The Robata grill offers an array of dishes, full of exciting flavours and textures. In addition, the menu also features dishes from the main kitchen and a selection of sushi and sashimi.

properties.popup_body:
It's the largest Waitrose branch in the country, and now Waitrose Canary Wharf is packing even more of a punch. Since its refurbishment, the wow-factor has been ramped up with a fresh look and new places to eat and drink.

At the mall level, you'll find everything foodie. From lunch on the move to ingredients for dinner tonight and our award-winning wine department with temperature-controlled wine room is justly famous ‚Äì and now you can enjoy any bottle that takes your fancy in the new Wine Bar.

Our Ground floor cafe is now open so you can relax and enjoy freshly made hot drinks, plus delicious dishes made from the same quality ingredients you can buy in store.

properties.name: Get a Drip
properties.popup_body:
Get A Drip has been disrupting the wellness industry since 2017 by being the first UK high street Vitamin Drip and Booster Shot provider. With locations around London including Boxpark Shoreditch, Westfield Shepherd’s Bush, and now Canary Wharf!
Founded in 2017 by Richard Chambers, he discovered the power of Vitamin Drips after being admitted to intensive care with Ketoacidosis due to complications with his Type 1 Diabetes. Since launching, Get A Drip have administered over 20,000 Vitamins Drips and are already the UK’s leading Vitamin Drip company. Get A Drip was also the first Vitamin Drip clinic in the world to introduce DNA tests to enable customers to create bespoke Vitamin Drips based on their own unique genetic requirements.

Location: Cabot Place

properties.name: Wahaca
properties.popup_body:
Wahaca brings the spirit of Mexican market eating to the UK: respect for quality ingredients, passion for vibrant, fresh and honest food and the pleasure of sharing with others. Everything is ethically sourced so you can get messy with a clear conscience by sharing tacos and quesadillas, washed down with fresh hibiscus water or a delicious cocktail. Make sure you leave room for churros - crispy sugared doughnuts - that come with a decadent hot chocolate dipping sauce!
